product_overview: A cinematic marketing landing page for 21TechGlory Agency that showcases services, portfolio work, testimonials, and pricing. Visitors can explore the page and open a project-start modal to initiate contact.
core_goals: Learn about the agency’s services and capabilities
Review portfolio examples and client testimonials
Understand pricing options and service tiers
Start a new project inquiry through the modal

user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll down the page -> View the services section -> Continue scrolling -> View the portfolio section -> Continue scrolling -> View the testimonials section -> Continue scrolling -> View the pricing section
Navigate to / -> Scroll down the page -> Observe cinematic 3D and motion animations as the page sections appear -> Continue exploring the content sections
